title: KEMI Module Functions
description: The following sections list all exported KEMI functions. More information regarding a function can be found by clicking the KEMI prototype, which will take you to the original module's documentation.
search: KEMI Module Functions

title: htable.sht_dec
description: Do atomic decrement to the item value. It returns the new value or -255 if the hash table does not exist, or the item does not exist or the item value is not integer.

title: htable.sht_get
description: If the item does not exists, it returns NULL. Note that NULL might be represented differently in various scripting languages, such as nil or None.

title: htable.sht_gete
description: Return the integer or string value of the item. If the item does not exists, it returns an empty string.

title: htable.sht_getw
description: If the item does not exists, it returns the string <null>, suitable for use when writing log messages.

title: htable.sht_inc
description: Do atomic increment to the item value. It returns the new value or -255 if the hash table does not exist, or the item does not exist or the item value is not integer.

title: kx.get_body
description: Return the body of the SIP message (the value of $rb).

title: kx.get_conid
description: Return the connection id for TCP, TLS and WebSocket, or -1 if no stream connection corresponds to current SIP message.

title: kx.get_duri
description: Return the value of destination URI ($du).

title: kx.get_rhost
description: Return the Request URI host (domain) part ($rd).

title: kx.get_ruser
description: Return the Request URI user part ($rU).

title: kx.header
description: Functions exported by kemix module and available in KEMI language under KSR.kx. They aim to provide a convenient way to retrieve string or integer values for most commonly used variables or runtime environment attributes

title: rtpengine.header
description: This module enables media streams to be proxied via RTPEngine, exporting the functions to interact with it.

title: rtpengine.set_rtpengine_set2
description: This function is the sibling function to set_rtpengine_set(). The original module function is declared as set_rtpengine_set(setid[, setid2]).

title: textopsx.bl_iterator_value
description: Return the content of the body line for the current position of the cursor, including the EoL.

title: tls.cget
description: Return values corresponding the pseudo-variables exported by TLS module, related to TLS connection and certificates. The parameter has to be the name of the pseudo-variable (without $).
